# Is It Worth Finishing?

> Decision tool for a game backlog: given the hours left, how much you are
> enjoying it and what else is waiting, it tells you whether to finish a game
> or drop it. Logic, not opinions.

Runs entirely in the browser. No account, and nothing you type is uploaded.

- [Home and tool](https://worthit.geeknite.com/)
- [Privacy](https://worthit.geeknite.com/privacy.html)

## Full index

- [Sitemap](https://worthit.geeknite.com/sitemap.xml)

## Usage policy

- Indexing: allowed.
- Answer-time citation: allowed and welcome. Please link back to the page used.
- Training or corpus collection: not allowed.

This repeats the `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no` line in
https://worthit.geeknite.com/robots.txt, which is where the policy is enforced.

The verdict is computed from what the reader enters. It is not a review of any
game and carries no score for one.
